# Car PDI Masters

> Car PDI Masters provides new-car pre-delivery inspection (PDI) and used-car inspection services across Delhi and Gurugram, India.

## Inspection scope
The inspection uses a structured 300+ checkpoint framework. Paint thickness readings are taken on applicable panels. OBD scanning is available only where the selected package and vehicle are compatible. Findings are based on observable condition and the checks included in the selected inspection workflow; an inspection does not guarantee that every concealed defect or historical event will be identified.

## Booking
Customers enquire by phone or WhatsApp. The team confirms location access and appointment availability, then shares the next booking steps. Car PDI Masters performs the inspection; CarParakh is used for booking coordination after availability is confirmed.

## Important
Service availability depends on location, vehicle access, appointment timing and selected package. Prices and package inclusions should be confirmed on the official website or with the team before booking.
